meta.name: agent-launcher-orchestrator
meta.description: Use when a user wants to build, launch, grade, or schedule a Claude Managed Agent (CMA) in their own Anthropic account — "build me an agent", "launch this as a managed agent", "run this on a schedule", "grade my agent against a rubric", "set up a nightly worker". Reads the per-session goal (./my-agent/goal.json), routes deterministically to one of five phase sub-skills (interview → stage-launch → grade-iterate → run-without-you → wrap-up) via goal_router.py, and compiles the goal+phase into an execution shape (single-pass workflow / bounded grade→iterate loop / recurring cron deployment loop) via loop_compiler.py. Forks context so heavy intake (build sheets, payloads, eval cases) stays out of the parent thread. All launches are emitted as BYOK curl the user runs with their own key; no tool makes API calls. Inspired by anthropics/launch-your-agent (Apache-2.0). Distinct from engineering/agent-harness (generic domain loop) and engineering/write-a-skill (authors Claude Code skills, not CMAs).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 构建并发布你自己的托管智能体,支持定时运行与考核
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你希望在 Anthropic 上创建并持续管理自己的托管智能体
copy.tagline_en: Build and launch your own managed agents with scheduling and grading
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to create and manage your own managed agents on Anthropic

howto.what: 它根据你的一句话目标,判断该走哪个阶段:访谈、构建、评分、无人值守运行或收尾,并生成对应的执行计划(单次、评分循环或定时任务)。启动代理时,它只输出一条用你自己密钥运行的 curl 命令,自己从不调用 API。
howto.when: 当你想构建、启动、评分等管理 Claude 托管代理时触发;若没有目标或目标含糊,它会先要求你把任务说成一句话。

say.text: 帮我做一个托管代理,每天整理收件箱。
say.note: 它会先访谈确认任务,再生成构建步骤。

say.text: 让这个代理每周一早上9点自动运行。
say.note: 它会生成一个定时循环的部署计划。

say.text: 按这份评分标准给代理的运行结果打分,再改进。
say.note: 它会进入评分-改进循环,循环次数有上限。

howto.what_en: It reads your one-sentence goal, routes to one of five phases, and compiles an execution plan (single-pass, grade-iterate, or cron loop). On launch it emits a BYOK curl for you to run with your own key; it never calls APIs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to build, launch, or grade a Claude Managed Agent; if no goal or a vague goal exists, it asks for a one-sentence goal first.

say_en.text: Help me build a managed agent to organize my inbox daily.
say_en.note: It interviews you, then generates build steps.

say_en.text: Run this agent automatically every Monday at 9am.
say_en.note: It generates a recurring cron deployment plan.

say_en.text: Grade the agent's runs against this rubric, then improve it.
say_en.note: It enters a bounded grade-then-iterate loop.
